subject: general
question: Which of the following folk songs and dances was inscribed on the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2010?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Kalbelia.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Kalbelia's costume and dance movements are similar to the serpents.**
 
• **In 2010 UNESCO inscribed Kalbelia in the representative list of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.**
 
• Kalbelia is a sensuous folk dance performed by the women of the Kalbelia community in **Rajasthan.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
